<!-- pr-reviewer: 6aafadfdb131a9be5866503b73ea7cb3a8ed2b37 -->

**Needs changes before merge.**

**What looks good**
- `posting::post_path` is a small pure helper. It reuses `builtin_post_path`, which resolves the assets directory once (`OnceLock`). No disk read happens per frame.
- The layering is right: the ui dialog only calls a pure app function. No state change, so no command is needed.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/2292-show-post-path.md`, the `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #2292` are all present. Commit subjects follow the convention.

**Results** (built locally in a trial-merge worktree with `origin/main`; clippy at -j 4, builds clean)

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (merged) | 1044 passed, **1 failed**, 6 ignored |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- --exact desktop_post_command_opens_dialog_and_applies_declared_script_options_undoably` on pure origin/main | ok |
| New test `post_dialog_shows_the_shipped_post_path` (merged) | ok |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test posting` (merged) | 17 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The failing binary output:

```
thread 'egui_app::post_dialog_tests::desktop_post_command_opens_dialog_and_applies_declared_script_options_undoably' panicked at
crates\ui\src\egui_app\post_dialog_tests.rs:60:5:
assertion failed: h.query_by_label_contains("No operations").is_some()
```

**Requested before merge**
1. The full path text in the Post dialog header breaks an existing test with a long install path. This review ran from a checkout with a 75-character path. The long scope label widens the header row, and the tab click at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tests.rs:60` then no longer reaches the dialog's "Operations" tab. The test passes on pure `origin/main`, and it passes with the same code when the suffix is a short string instead of the path. Keep the header row width stable: for example draw the scope label with a width cap and an elide, and put the full path in a tooltip; or draw the path on its own row below the tab row. Update the pinning test to match, so it does not depend on the checkout path length.
2. Add before/after screenshots of the Post dialog to the PR body. This PR changes a UI dialog, and the body has none.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs` gains one blank line at the end. Drop it.
- The test passed on your machine because the checkout path is short there. A length-independent fix (point 1) keeps it green everywhere.

@FlamingFireCoding Thank you for the clean helper and the decision note. Please fix point 1, then push; we will re-check.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 61128cf41baca3e5ed7785ea8b3f6c9bd8dabe19 -->

**Needs changes before merge.**

**What looks good**
- The header fix works. The scope line now shows only the post name. The full path moves to the hover tooltip (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog.rs:143-155`). The header width no longer depends on the checkout path length.
- The test that failed in the last review passes now. The pinning test `post_dialog_shows_the_shipped_post_path` no longer asserts on path text, so it is length-independent.
- The stray blank lines at the end of `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs` are gone.
- The merge of main is clean. Its remerge-diff is empty.

**Results** (run locally in a review worktree. The PR head already contains main `3e47b898b`, so the checkout is the merged tree.)

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 1055 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored |
| `desktop_post_command_opens_dialog_and_applies_declared_script_options_undoably` (--exact) | ok |
| `post_dialog_shows_the_shipped_post_path` (--exact) | ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | **failed** |

The clippy output:

```
error: useless use of `format!`
   --> crates\ui\src\egui_app\post_dialog.rs:150:33
    |
150 |                         None => format!("{post_label}"),
    |                                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ help: consider using `.to_string()`: `post_label.to_string()`
```

**Requested before merge**
1. Fix the clippy error at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog.rs:150`. `format!` has one argument there. Write `post_label.to_string()` instead. Then run `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` and confirm it is clean.
2. Add before/after screenshots of the Post dialog to the PR body. The last review asked for them, and the body still has none. In the "after" shot, please also show the tooltip open, so a reader can see the path reveal.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- The pinning test no longer asserts that the dialog shows the path anywhere. A structural test cannot hover the label, so the tooltip itself is untested. The test still checks that `posting::post_path` resolves to a non-empty path, which is reasonable.

@FlamingFireCoding Thank you for the fast fix. The layout problem from the last review is gone. Please fix the clippy error and add the screenshots, then push. We will re-check.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 2840b3e16603f7663151751f17f41d7d124693c5 -->

**Needs changes before merge.** The build and the tests are clean. Two small items from the last review are still open.

**What looks good**
- The clippy error is fixed. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog.rs:150` now uses `post_label.to_string()`. Clippy is clean (table below).
- The header fix from the last head still holds. The scope line shows only the post name. The full path is on hover through `posting::post_path` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog.rs:143-156`).
- `post_path` matches how main resolves posts: a `Named` post must be a `BUILTINS` entry, and a user file gets `None`. No panic path. The layering ui -> app is correct.
- The delta commit has a conventional subject.

**Results** (run locally in a review worktree, Windows. The head contains main `3e47b898b`; the trial merge is "Already up to date".)

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 1055 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored |
| `post_dialog_shows_the_shipped_post_path` | ok |
| `desktop_post_command_opens_dialog_and_applies_declared_script_options_undoably` | ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib posting` | 9 passed, 0 failed |

The desktop test passed at a long checkout path (`...\Claude-001\.claude\worktrees\cc-pr2352-review\...`), so the header no longer depends on path length.

**Requested before merge**
1. Put the before/after screenshots in the PR body. The last review asked for them there. They are now in your comment of 2026-11-18, which is good, but the body still has none. Also add one shot with no tooltip open, so a reader can see the quiet header row. The two you posted both show the tooltip.
2. Update `docs/decisions/2292-show-post-path.md`. Its first paragraph still says the dialog shows the path inline beside the name: `Fanuc (built-in) (C:\...\assets\posts\fanuc.cps)`. The shipped design shows only the name, with the path in the hover tooltip. Write what the code now does.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- In your screenshots the tooltip runs to the edge of the picture. egui clamps tooltips to the viewport, so the file name is probably still readable on screen. No action needed unless a user reports it cut off.
- Like the last review noted, the tooltip text itself is not covered by a structural test. That stays acceptable.

@FlamingFireCoding Good work on the layout and the clippy fix. Only the two small items above remain. Push them, and we will re-check.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
